newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Chubais shown meeting on television.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Chubais shown meeting on television.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin was shown meeting his chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais in film released by Russian Television on Thursday.

In some 20 seconds of film, Yeltsin smiled, gestured with both arms and could be heard discussing the state of the economy with Chubais. The Kremlin press service said poor tax collection and wage arrears were on the agenda.

Exterior shots showed the autumnal woods around the Barvikha sanatorium near Moscow, where Yeltsin moved from hospital last weekend to continue preparations for a heart bypass operation due in the next two months.
A statement released after the meeting in the sanatorium said Yeltsin had ordered government officials to declare their income for 1996.
Yeltsin, 65, has met several officials at Barvikha this week. Before moving there he spent over three weeks in a Moscow hospital.
The Kremlin statement said Yeltsin described the current wage situation as unacceptable.

"Students, teachers, the military and other workers in the state sphere are not receiving wages because a number of big enterprises are literally taking the finances of the country by the throat and refusing to pay taxes," he said.
The statement said the meeting lasted for about an hour.

Tax evasion is one of the biggest economic problems facing the Russian government this year and income lags well behind budgeted levels. Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin has said he expects collection rates to improve in October or November.
Wage arrears are also a major issue and workers across Russia have gone on strike to complain that they have not been paid for months.
